mainEntity.name: How much does a Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D (2AD-FHV or 2AD-FTV) engine costs £500-£1,200 supply-only; reconditioned units are £1,200-£2,200; fully rebuilt engines range from £2,000-£3,500 supply-only [EM-QUOTE]. Fitting adds approximately £650-£910 in labour at an independent 4x4 specialist (10-14 hours).

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D 2AD-FHV and 2AD-FTV?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 2AD-FHV produces 177hp, while the 2AD-FTV produces 150hp. Both are 2.2-litre common-rail diesel engines fitted to the XA30 RAV4 from 2006-2013. The 2AD-FHV was the higher-performance variant, offering stronger towing capability and quicker acceleration; the 2AD-FTV was the more economical option. They share the same core architecture and common failure points - SCV failure, oil consumption and DPF clogging.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of SCV failure in a Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common symptom is the engine starting normally from cold, then stalling after 20-30 seconds. The problem disappears once the engine warms up. You may also experience rough idling, hesitation on acceleration and, in some cases, no fault codes stored in the ECU.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D (2006-2013) is worth approximately £3,000-£8,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A reconditioned or rebuilt engine at £1,200-£3,500 supply-only represents 20-60% of the vehicle's value - which can be viable, especially if the car is otherwise well-maintained and has strong 4x4 capability.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional engine replacement on a Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D typically takes 10-14 working hours for an experienced 4x4 specialist. Allow 3-5 working days from workshop drop-off to collection, depending on parts availability and workshop workload.

mainEntity.name: How reliable is the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D 2AD-FHV / 2AD-FTV engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Toyota 2.2 D-4D (2AD-FHV and 2AD-FTV) is generally a durable and torquey diesel engine, with many examples exceeding 150,000 miles when properly maintained. However, it has known weak points: SCV (Suction Control Valve) failure, excessive oil consumption, DPF clogging on urban vehicles, EGR valve clogging and timing chain wear.

historyTimeline.h2: Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D diesel engine - available in two states of tune as 2AD-FHV (177hp) and 2AD-FTV (150hp) - powered the third-generation XA30 RAV4 through its production run from 2006 to 2013. Known for its strong torque and towing capability, the 2.2 D-4D was the engine of choice for UK RAV4 buyers seeking a capable, fuel-efficient diesel SUV before the hybrid era.

milestones.description: **2006** - XA30 RAV4 launched with 2.2 D-4D engine (2AD-FHV, 177hp)
**2008** - Suction Control Valve (SCV) improvement introduced via Toyota TSB EG-0132T-1110-EN
**2013** - XA30 RAV4 production ends; 2.2 D-4D replaced by hybrid powertrains in XA40 generation

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D (2AD-FHV and 2AD-FTV) is a capable and torquey diesel, but the 2AD engine family has several well-documented weak points that can lead to expensive repairs. Oil consumption, SCV failure and DPF clogging are the most common failure drivers for the 2AD-FHV and 2AD-FTV. Rebuilt 2.2 D-4D engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: SCV (Suction Control Valve) Failure - Why the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D Stalls When Cold
problems.rootCause: The Suction Control Valve (SCV) on the high-pressure fuel pump fails or becomes contaminated, causing fuel rail pressure fluctuations during cold starts. The engine starts normally, then stalls after 20-30 seconds; the problem disappears once the engine warms up. Toyota issued TSB EG-0132T-1110-EN addressing this issue.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace SCV valve (Toyota part #04226-26030 for RAV4)
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early; resolves cold-start stalling

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace SCV, flush fuel system, inspect injectors

repairOptions.longevity: Best if other issues present or high mileage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D (2006-2013) is worth approximately £3,000-£8,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. If your RAV4 is worth under ~£4,000, an SCV-only repair or used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. For vehicles worth £4,000-£6,000, evaluate both options; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. For vehicles worth £6,000+, a reconditioned or rebuilt engine usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability.
problems.recommendation: If your Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D is stalling on cold starts and you have no other symptoms, the SCV-only repair at an independent specialist offers the best value - typically under £500 fitted. If the engine has high mileage (over 120,000 miles) or exhibits other symptoms like oil consumption, DPF issues or timing chain noise, a full replacement with a reconditioned or rebuilt 2AD-FHV or 2AD-FTV unit is the more cost-effective long-term decision.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt 2AD-FHV Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D engine prices

problems.h4: Excessive Oil Consumption - Why the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D Burns Oil
problems.rootCause: The 2AD engine family is known for excessive oil consumption. Worn piston rings, PCV valve failure and turbocharger seal wear can all contribute to oil burning. Symptoms include blue smoke from the exhaust, frequent oil top-ups between services and sooting of the EGR valve.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace PCV valve; inspect breather system
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if oil consumption is mild

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace piston rings; engine strip-down required
repairOptions.longevity: Significant labour; only worthwhile if engine otherwise healthy
Best for high-mileage engines with multiple issues

problems.recommendation: Oil consumption on the 2AD-FHV and 2AD-FTV is often a sign of wear rather than a single component failure. If your Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D is consuming more than 1 litre of oil per 1,000 miles, have a full engine inspection carried out. For high-mileage RAV4 2.2 D-4D examples (over 120,000 miles), a full replacement with a reconditioned 2AD-FHV or 2AD-FTV engine often makes more sense than investing in piecemeal repairs.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt 2AD-FTV Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D engine prices

problems.h4: DPF Clogging - Why the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D Loses Power
problems.rootCause: The Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) on 2.2 D-4D models becomes clogged with soot, especially on vehicles used primarily for short urban journeys. Symptoms include loss of power, limp mode (engine limited to 3,000 rpm), DPF warning light, failed regenerations and white smoke during regeneration attempts.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Diagnostic tool-forced regeneration; requires 45+ minute motorway run
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if DPF is only partially blocked

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Chemical cleaning using DPF cleaning fluid
Replace DPF with new or professionally cleaned unit
repairOptions.longevity: Best if DPF is beyond regeneration

problems.recommendation: DPF issues on the Toyota RAV4 2.2 D-4D are often preventable with regular motorway driving to allow passive regeneration. If your RAV4 is primarily used for short urban trips, consider a forced regeneration or chemical clean as a first step. If the DPF is beyond recovery or you have other engine issues, a full replacement with a reconditioned 2AD-FHV or 2AD-FTV engine - with warranty - is the most reliable long-term solution.
